admission_requirements.general_requirements: Jordanian Tawjihi certificate (Scientific stream) or equivalent; university entrance exam and interview; competitive admission based on exam score and Tawjihi average
admission_requirements.exam_details: All applicants must take a 30-minute entrance exam measuring English, intelligence, logic, communication skills, and mathematics; followed by an interview with the school committee

college_names: King Hussein School of Computing Sciences
King Abdullah II School of Engineering
King Talal School of Business Technology
King Abdullah I School of Graduate Studies & Scientific Research

tuition_fees.notes: Tuition fees vary by program. Registration fee 375 JOD (first time), 300 JOD thereafter. Transportation fee 100 JOD/semester. Payment via eFAWATEERcom, Visa, or MasterCard.

ranking_accreditation.accreditation: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (MOHE), ABET (5 programs), AACSB, EUR-ACE, EQUIS (King Talal School of Business Technology, 2026)
ranking_accreditation.international_recognition: QS World University Rankings 901-950 (2026); US News Best Global Universities #445 (2026); QS Arab University Rankings #44 (2024); QS Employment Index global rank #73; QS 5 Stars Plus

market_demand.notes: PSUT scored 3.8/4 on IFC employability scale (Jordan average 2.6). Annual Career Fair with 50+ leading companies. QS Employment Index global rank 73. University advisory boards include industry experts and company managers.

campus_facilities.accommodation_details: No on-campus student housing. Private student residences, hotel apartments, and hotels available in the Al-Jubaiha area near campus.
campus_facilities.scholarship_details: Graduate assistantships and Emerging Researcher Scholarship for graduate students. Deans' Council determines grants and discounts for high-achieving undergraduate students annually. Sports excellence grants available.

contact_info.address: Khalil Saket Street, Al-Jubeiha 11941, P.O. Box 1438, Amman, Jordan
